title: Ready for FRMCS: Ericsson shows the path from validation to rollout at InnoTrans 2026
summary: At InnoTrans 2026, September 22–25 at Messe Berlin, Ericsson will demonstrate how railway operators can move the 5G-based Future Railway Mobile Communication System (FRMCS) from testing toward future deployment. Ericsson will show a practical path to get there – supporting migration from GSM-R and enabling critical operations and passenger connectivity on one secure network.
